property_summary: Any transferFrom call on a token that is not minted (its owner is address(0)) must revert, so ownerOf(id) can never become non-zero through an unminted transfer; the mutant lets msg.sender==from bypass the ownership check and silently assigns unminted tokens, making such calls succeed.
change_summary: Replace the `from == _ownerOf[id]` check with a trivial from-not-zero check, allowing unauthorized parties to move any token, so _ownerOf changes for tokens P would not allow moving.
